title: Haye Mere Qasim Haye Qasim
body:
HAYE MERE QASIM HAYE QASIM
Karna Saki Wo Raaj Mai
Rakli Teri Wo Laaj Mai
Bewa Bani Hun Aaj Mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bin Tere Haye Qasim
Maqtal Ko Kya Sajaye Ho
Wada Bhi Kya Nibhaye Ho
Soughat Ye Bhijaye Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyon Tumna Aaye Qasim
Kya Haal Ye Banaye Ho
Jalwa Hame Dikhaye Ho
Pamal Hoke Aaye Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon Me Nahaye Qasim
Haathoun Me Chudhiya Thi Jab
Paoun Me Bediya Hai Ab
Loge Qabar Meri Ye Kab
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Tho Batao Qasim
Hota Hai Dil Ko Dar Hame
Milta Nahi Hai Ghar Hame
Dekhe Ye Ahle Shar Hame
<<DIVIDER>>
Dar-Dar Phiraye Qasim
Waris Khuda Ke Dil Ke The
Malik Bhi Hum Zami Ke The
Kabe Ke Us Makki Ke The
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalim Sathaye Qasim
